'''Clone scout trooper armor''' was flexible, lightweight [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]] used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Clone scout trooper/Legends|clone scout troopers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Description==
[[File:UnidentifiedSwampTrooper-ROTS.png|thumb|left|150px|Camouflaged clone scout trooper armor.]]
[[Clone scout trooper/Legends|Clone scout trooper]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]]<ref name="CW Campaign Guide" /> weighed ten [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]], was flexible, and was lighter than [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]]<ref name="CotF: Preview 3" /> at the cost of its own protection.<ref name="SWC:TP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> It measured at least 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="Height" /> and had a [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Body glove/Legends|body glove]] under its armor plates. The armor's [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] had a unique design compared to other [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] helmets, with a wide visor<ref name="SWE3" /> that gave its wearer better visibility.<ref name="CotF: Preview 3" /> Furthermore, the helmet's visor could either be black<ref name="GGAR" /> or have a green hue.<ref name="SWE3" /> 

Standard clone [[Scout/Legends|scout]] armor was white,<ref name="GGAR" /> but it could be painted with a camouflage pattern for better concealment in [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]], [[Desert/Legends|desert]], or [[Forest/Legends|forested]] environments. The [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Legion's]] clone scout troopers painted their armor with a jungle camouflage pattern instead of using the armor's standard white color. Clone scout trooper armor also had an integrated [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]],<ref name="CotF: Preview 3" /> eighteen equipment pouches,<ref name="SWE3" /> and a [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]] carrying a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]].<ref name="CW Campaign Guide" />

==History==
Clone scout trooper armor saw use by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] clone scout troopers during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], including during the [[Battle of Felucia  (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|Battle of Felucia]], the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]],<ref name="SW:BF2" /> and the [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|Battle of Saleucami]].<ref name="Republic 79" /> Clone scout trooper armor also saw use under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], where it was used by an Imperial clone scout trooper during the [[Battle of Otavon XII]].<ref name="Hidden Blade" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clone scout trooper armor first appeared, albeit unnamed, in {{Film|III}} a [[2005]] film written and directed by [[George Lucas]].<ref name="SWE3" /> It was later identified in ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'',<ref name="CW Campaign Guide" /> a [[2009]] hardcover supplement for the ''[[Saga Edition]]'' [[roleplaying game]], written by [[Rodney Thompson]], [[J.D. Wiker]], [[Patrick Stutzman]], [[Gary Astleford]], [[T. Rob Brown]], and published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="WoTC CW:CG">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/CloneWarsCampaignGuide|text=''The Clone Wars Campaign Guide''}}</ref>
